name: singlet_reference_mapping_query_embedding_projection
title: Map query cells into a frozen reference
description: Projects query cells into a frozen reference embedding and returns query coordinates, label predictions with a confidence, and a novelty score per cell. The default method symphony is deterministic and CPU-friendly and needs a reference built by the reference construction task; scarches_scvi, scanvi_query and scpoli need a saved reference model and may train on the query, so they can queue. The reference is never modified. Do not use it to build a reference, to name clusters from markers, or to tune thresholds on the query.

dataset.description: Query dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI, or a workspace handle. Outputs are written here only.

ref_name.description: Name of the frozen reference artefacts to use (models, uns and obsm members). Required; no default.

method.description: Mapping method. symphony is the default; deep methods need a saved reference model.

batch_key.description: Query obs column naming batch or study; used by symphony correction and deep-model query training.

k_neighbors.description: Reference neighbours per query cell for the query-to-reference graph and the novelty score.

symphony.description: Options used only when method is symphony.

sigma.description: Soft-assignment fuzziness; smaller values approach hard cluster assignment.

lambda_ridge.description: Ridge penalty on the non-intercept coefficients of the query batch correction. The reference code fixes it at 1 (src/utils.cpp:76-78) and takes no argument.

k_label.description: Reference neighbours in the label vote.

correct.description: Apply the per-cluster batch correction; false returns the linear PCA projection.

scvi.description: Options used only by scarches_scvi and scanvi_query.

freeze_expression.description: Keep reference expression weights frozen during query training.

scpoli.description: Options used only by scpoli query training.

seed.description: Random seed for deep-model query training; symphony mapping is deterministic.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/my_reference_label_pred. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Completed runs: method, n_query_cells, n_reference_cells, gene_overlap_fraction, k_neighbors, label_confidence_median, novelty_median, warnings. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
